organizations.name: farmers & merchants bank of central california

text:
There are only five articles (including this one) on Seeking Alpha which cover Farmers & Merchants Bancorp ( OTCQX:FMCB ) - one of which was written by the present author.
Why the lack of interest? Perhaps because Farmers & Merchants Bancorp is the holding company of Farmers & Merchants Bank of Central California, a small community bank based in Lodi, California which serves customers in its twenty-five branches across the Central Valley and East Bay. Furthermore, it is a small-cap firm, with a market capitalization of $523.33 million. Such characteristics are not likely to entice those investors drawn to the likes of Alphabet ( GOOG ) ( GOOGL ), Amazon ( AMZN ), Apple ( AAPL ), Facebook ( FB ), Netflix ( NFLX ), and Tesla ( TSLA ).
Another potential turn off is the fact that Farmers & Merchants Bancorp does not trade on a listed exchange such as the NYSE or NASDAQ, but on the over the counter or OTC markets. Add to that the fact that one share trades for almost $650 at present, and the lack of interest in the company is somewhat understandable.
However, for investors seeking reliable long-term income, Farmers & Merchants Bancorp may be just the sort of company one would want in a portfolio. The firm is conservatively managed, which is why it has been able to stay in business since 1916. And while a number of national banks suffered during the late-2000s, Farmers & Merchants Bancorp were able to continue rewarding their shareholders with consecutively rising dividends, which the company has done since 1965, making it a Dividend King.
